title: Confirm
description: x-confirm puts a confirmation dialog in front of a click: the dialog shows confirmTitle and confirmMessage with OK and Cancel buttons, and fires wb:confirm:ok or wb:confirm:cancel.

heading.description: Dialog heading. Only used when `confirmTitle` is absent.

message.description: Body text. Only used when `confirmMessage` is absent.

confirmText.description: Label on the confirming button. Defaults to `OK`.

cancelText.description: Label on the dismissing button. Defaults to `Cancel`.

confirmTitle.description: Dialog heading. Read BEFORE `heading`; defaults to `Confirm`.

confirmMessage.description: Body text. Read BEFORE `message`; defaults to `Are you sure?`.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
